description.subject: A small figure with an egg-shaped shell form, a dot-eyed face and a single wavy line above the eyes, standing as a posed toy or prop.
description.covering: It wears a red woolen sweater with a thick rolled collar and long sleeves, tan work overalls with flap pockets on the thighs, white gloves on the hands and tawny rubber-style boots reaching the ankles.
description.posture: It stands upright on its two feet, holding a glossy amber glass sphere against its chest in white-gloved hands, facing the camera.
description.setting: It stands on a bed of small smooth river stones in cream, rust, grey and slate tones, with a curved weathered wooden dish or bowl and more stones blurred behind it.
description.light: Warm, golden sunlight comes from the upper left and behind, casting crisp highlights on the egg shell and the glass sphere, with a soft blurred background.
description.materials: Smooth egg shell, red yarn, tan canvas-like fabric, polished amber glass, rounded stones and weathered wood.
